_source: Facility manager messages, 45 triggers x 5 wordings, accepted by Carlos Oct 9 (manager-messages-draft.md v4). Priority: 1 injuries and health, 2 damage, level drops and maintenance, 3 contracts and rival interest, 4 everything else. waitsFor = the system the trigger needs before it can fire. [brackets] are filled in by the game. repeatable (PROPOSAL): the monthly report is exempt from the no-repeat rules, since it comes 13 times a season and has 5 wordings. Oct 9 (squad and tactics): injuries, debuts and per-player regimes now exist, so 8 more triggers are live (35 of 45). Coaches (Oct 9 night): 3 more live (38 of 45). Scouting (Oct 9 night): 4 more live (42 of 45).
